summary: ArgoCDTools is laid out one folder per image: argocd-hook/ holds its Dockerfile, .dockerignore, presync/, image/ and tests/ as a self-contained kaniko context, and the root keeps only repo-wide files. .kubecoder/project.yaml declares root (description, jenkins, repo-wide ruff) and argocd-hook (test, build), and the Jenkinsfile wraps the kaniko call in dir('argocd-hook'). kc project lint, test and build are all green from the repo root.
